The county ballot-title PDF linked from the election page returned only the multilingual accommodations notice (likely an image scan). Ballot question, summary and official bond amount not found on a readable official page; amount and tax-rate statement come from the district's Clackamas High bond page (published 2026-07-06, before the board's final June/July action, so verify against the ballot title). Main district bond page (https://www.nclack.k12.or.us/about-ncsd/bond2026) renders no body text to WebFetch.
